item.title: N-methylaniline exposure likely caused methemoglobinemia in maritime migration
item.description: In a case series of severe acquired methemoglobinemia among migrants to Italy, prolonged skin exposure to fuel-contaminated seawater was identified as the likely cause.

item.title: Rare cortical neurons can synchronize brain activity and promote sleep in mice
item.description: For nearly a century, scientists have looked to deep brain structures to explain sleep. New research points to rare cortical neurons that synchronize activity and promote sleep in mice.

item.title: Hurricane season is a fifth season, and medicine has to plan for it [PODCAST]
item.description: In South Louisiana, hurricane season is treated like a fifth season, and medicine must plan accordingly. Subscribe to The Podcast by KevinMD.

item.title: Training nurses like athletes
item.description: Chandler Browning always dreamed of joining The University of Texas at Arlington's nationally recognized nursing program and pursuing her goal.
